title: Prompt Injection Attacks on LLM Generated Reviews of Scientific Publications

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distribution of LLM-generated review scores under neutral prompts against human reference reviews to measure the models' inherent tendency to give positive ratings and recommend acceptance.

Embedding hidden positively- or negatively-biased text instructions into PDF submissions and measuring the subsequent directional shift in the LLM-generated numerical review scores and qualitative arguments.
